additional_info.subject: ID0389588-DC/Si-D/NL[STBpCB] - MID meter certificates + how to get meter values CRM:00315002043
additional_info.body:
Dear Thomas,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S5 170003680
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
STBpCB
Problem Description
: MID meter certificates and how to get meter values from the meters.
Troubleshooting
:
Easy question first, how to get the meter values:
As you know, you can get the meter values via OCPP with the MeterValue command, by using Energy.Active.Import.Register, you can choose “Outlet” which will refer to the DC1 or DC2, or you can choose “Inlet” which will refer to the AC income meter, this will provide the whole energy transfer value.
You can also check the values locally on the HMI of the LEMs.
Regarding the MID meter certificates:
AC income meter (Siemens)
MID/LNE certified → I couldn't find the document where it says that it's certified but this information was found in the R&D wiki. If you need this specific document I recommend you to reach out to your RM and formally request to PLM. If I request it, it will be left in the background.
Bauer AC Meter (AC charging)
ERK certified → no mention of MID certification
LEM DC Meter
I cannot share with you the document that LEM manufacturer has it says “Not for publication unless permission is granted by LEM”. But here is the certification for all the LEM meters we have.
Device Tag: -
BC
X
.
Y
X:
1 = DC1 (Left)
2 = DC2 (Right)
203 = DC3 Dispenser Left
(Dispenser devices always start with 200-number to immediately show it's located in a different housing)
204 = DC4 Dispenser Right
(Dispenser devices always start with 200-number to immediately show it's located in a different housing)
Y:
1 = Display unit (aka. Metering unit, in front door)
2 = Sensor Unit 400 A non-ERK
3 = Sensor Unit 600 A non-ERK
4 = Sensor Unit 400 A ERK
5 = Sensor Unit 600 A ERK
6 = Sensor Unit 400 A MID
7 = Sensor Unit 600 A MID
14 = Sensor Unit 400 A ERK mit 4L Messung (400 kW)
15 = Sensor Unit 600 A ERK mit 4L Messung (400 kW)
16 = Sensor Unit 400 A MID mit 4L Messung (400 kW)
17 = Sensor Unit 600 A MID mit 4L Messung (400 kW)
Let me know if my answer was what you needed.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0389588
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
